author: Shekhar
review_text: I tried buying Ncell Pack through esewa last week. The transaction failed from Esewa to Ncell but my balance was still deducted. After hassles of daily calls to esewa customer center, they finally refunded my amount in a weeks time after everytime promising to refund within a day. How can this app be trusted for large transaction if they can't quickly resolve issue like this? They don't seem to have proper rollback mechanism. DO TRANSACTION with esewa at YOUR OWN RISK
